com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-credentials-hibp 00.74.00 发布, Optional Phase-5 extension that adds a HaveIBeenPwned-style online
    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jSentinel-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.

items.title:
com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-crypto-bc 00.74.00 发布, Optional Phase-1b extension that adds memory-hard and bcrypt-style
    password hashing providers backed by BouncyCastle (Argon2id,
    bcrypt, scrypt) on top of the V00.71 PasswordHashProvider SPI from
    jSentinel-core. Strictly opt-in: applications that do not depend on
    this module never pull in bcprov. Loading the module also does not
    touch the global JCA provider order — every algorithm is invoked
    through the BouncyCastle low-level Bouncy Castle Crypto APIs.

items.title:
com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-persistence-eclipsestore 00.74.00 发布, Eclipse-Store-backed implementations of every Phase-2 persistence
    store (AuditEvent, Session, LoginAttempt, RoleAssignment,
    BootstrapState, RememberMe / PasswordReset / EmailVerification
    tokens, ApiKey, RefreshToken, RateLimit). Each implementation is
    verified bit-for-bit against the contract shipped by
    jSentinel-persistence-testkit. The runtime root object
    (EclipseStoreJSentinelRoot) is package-private — applications
    consume the stores through their existing Phase-2 SPIs and
    control the lifecycle through the public
    EclipseStoreJSentinelStorage facade.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-processor 00.74.00 发布, Compile-time annotation processor that generates a Secured wrapper
    subclass for each @Secured-annotated concrete class. The generated
    wrapper routes every public, non-final, non-static method through
    JSentinelEnforcer when the method (or class) carries a method-security
    annotation (@RequiresRole, @RequiresPermission, @RequiresAnyPermission,
    @RequiresAllPermissions, @RequiresPolicy).

    Runtime sibling: SecuredProxy in jSentinel-standalone for the
    JDK-dynamic-proxy path on interfaces.
